notes: «فأخبرنا أن زيد بن ثابت أخبره»: who «أخبرنا» is cannot be settled. مروان بن الحكم sits in the scene and may be the one informing Sahl, or only part of the scene; he is not added (rule 6), so زيد بن ثابت is written directly after Sahl. This needs a ruling (rule 11)
the Prophet's dictation and the revelation are the saying; ابن أم مكتوم appears only in the story
